This is such a shame and so sad to see. @Kimi_Moonshot ruined their launch themselves. K3.1 pro is a great model and it did not need people to fake good reviews. But since they were trying to cheat the game it makes the whole launch look bad.

I did not receive this briefing and was not paid by kimi. But I can assure you, if I had known earlier that they tried to cheat the game and do illegal influencing, I wouldn’t have said one good thing about their model. 

Super sad to see. Hope @Kimi_Moonshot steps forward, apologizes, and promises never to say anything like that again, because reputation is what matters most.
